findings.reason: Checked: buildAuthorizationConditions returns a Prisma.Sql on every path, so authConditions is always truthy and the last two branches of getBaseConditions can never run; this is a correct cleanup point and nothing more.

Checked: the constructor now takes InsightsBookingServicePublicOptions with an optional teamId, so a team-scope call without teamId compiles, then fails safeParse and quietly returns the 1=0 condition; this is a real loss of type safety, but no production caller exists yet.
Checked: only the user-scope test runs the generated SQL with $queryRaw, and the org and team ANY(array) conditions are only compared as objects; this is a fair test gap but no defect is shown.
Checked: the Caching describe block was removed while the memoization in getAuthorizationConditions and getFilterConditions is still there, so caching is now untested on a non-critical path.
